meta.title: .NET Junior & Internship Opportunities in Egypt — April 2026
meta.description: Comprehensive research of .NET job market for fresh graduates in Egypt. Structured programs, active job listings, and government-funded training tracks.
meta.research_by: Web search across Wuzzuf, LinkedIn, GulfTalent, FounditGulf, Egyincs, MCIT, company career pages

market_summary.total_estimated_listings: ~2,900 'Junior Net Developer' on Wuzzuf; ~12 explicit junior .NET on GulfTalent; ~10+ structured fresh grad programs
market_summary.verdict: .NET has FEWER total listings than Node.js but offers MORE structured fresh grad programs with clear pipelines, less competition per opening, and strong enterprise/banking presence.
market_summary.nodejs_comparison: Node.js has more junior listings (~3,700) but higher competition ('oversupply' per LinkedIn 2024 report). .NET junior programs often require only OOP fundamentals + willingness to learn.
market_summary.best_bet: Structured programs (IBM, FlairsTech, AAIB, Valeo, talabatYouth) and government training (ITI ICC, DEPI, Digilians) are the easiest entry points — they target fresh grads explicitly.
market_summary.strategy: Apply to IBM and AAIB now (both open). Enroll in ITI ICC or DEPI .NET track for structured training. Use .NET profile to target enterprise/banking; keep Node.js profile for remote/startup roles.
